**6.2 Failure taxonomy**

Assign one **primary** category per miss, plus optional secondary categories. Use these codes:

| Code | Category | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| E1 | `extraction_missing_skill` | A must-have skill or experience is present in the raw JD/CV but missing from the LLM extraction |
| E2 | `keyword_merge_error` | Synonyms were not merged, or distinct skills were incorrectly merged |
| E3 | `representation_loss` | The AE bottleneck loses a discriminative skill; reconstruction is poor or the latent space collapses |
| E4 | `hard_negative_lookalike` | A role-similar CV outranks the hired CV; the top false positive is a genuine lookalike |
| E5 | `seniority_years_mismatch` | Years of experience or seniority level is the main discriminator and the model ignores it |
| E6 | `domain_industry_mismatch` | Industry/domain background (e.g. manufacturing finance, semiconductor field service) is the key missing signal |
| E7 | `location_language_constraint` | A hard location/citizenship/language filter in the JD is not modelled |
| E8 | `label_noise_or_recruiter_context` | The hired person is not the strongest on paper; hiring involved interview, salary, availability, or other context |
| E9 | `duplicate_or_pool_artifact` | Near-duplicate profiles crowd the top 10, or the candidate pool has an artefact |
| E10 | `other` | Anything else; explain in the comment |

For each miss, cite the evidence: the JD requirement, the CV text, the extracted keyword, the cluster, or the score. Do not assign a category without evidence.

## 6. Definition of done

The assignment is complete only when all of the following are true:

1. **Data**: 100 pool CVs, 10 hired CVs, 10 GT JDs, and 50 unlabelled JDs are accounted for; the candidate pool is 110 (or a justified adjusted count); `ground_truth.csv` has exactly 10 rows.
2. **Extraction**: the local LLM has attempted all 170 documents; success rate ≥ 95%; failures and unsupported keywords are logged; extraction quality is measured against Excel `Skills`.

CV_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"Anonymised candidate profile.*?Second Talent", re.IGNORECASE)
GT_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"Anonymised example.*?Second Talent", re.IGNORECASE)
CV_PAGE_RE = re.compile(r"^CV-\d{3}\s*·\s*page\s*\d+\s*$", re.MULTILINE)
P_PAGE_RE = re.compile(r"^P\d{2}\s*·\s*page\s*\d+\s*$", re.MULTILINE)
P_JD_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^P\d{2}\s*·\s*JOB DESCRIPTION\s*·.*$", re.MULTILINE)
P_CV_HEADER_RE = re.compile(r"^P\d{2}\s*·\s*CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE\s*$", re.MULTILINE)
HIRED_FOR_RE = re.compile(r"^Hired for:.*$", re.MULTILINE)

MARKER = "CV OF THE HIRED CANDIDATE"


def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def normalize_text(text):
    if text is None:
        return ""
    # normalize bullets
    text = text.replace("●", "-").replace("•", "-").replace("�", "-")
    # remove headers/footers
    text = CV_HEADER_RE.sub("", text)
    text = GT_HEADER_RE.sub("", text)
    text = CV_PAGE_RE.sub("", text)
    text = P_PAGE_RE.sub("", text)
    text = P_JD_HEADER_RE.sub("", text)
    # keep marker removal separate in split logic
    # collapse spaces/tabs but preserve newlines
    text = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r" *\n *", "\n", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    return text.strip()


def clean_cv_text(text):
    text = normalize_text(text)
    text = HIRED_FOR_RE.sub("", text)
    text = P_CV_HEADER_RE.sub("", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    return text.strip()


def clean_jd_text(text):
    text = normalize_text(text)
    # remove marker if accidentally included
    text = text.replace(MARKER, "")
    text = re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text)
    return text.strip()


def extract_pdf_text(path):
    import pymupdf
    doc = pymupdf.open(path)
    pages = []
    for page in doc:
        pages.append(page.get_text("text"))
    text = "\n".join(pages)
    return text, len(pages)


def split_gt_pdf(text):
    # find exact marker
    idx = text.find(MARKER)
    if idx == -1:
        raise ValueError(f"Marker '{MARKER}' not found")
    jd_raw = text[:idx]
    cv_raw = text[idx + len(MARKER):]
    return clean_jd_text(jd_raw), clean_cv_text(cv_raw)


def load_excel(xlsx_path):
    xls = pd.ExcelFile(xlsx_path)
    jd_df = pd.read_excel(xls, "JD Examples")
    cv_df = pd.read_excel(xls, "CV Examples")
    return jd_df, cv_df


def mask_pii(text):
    if not text:
        return text
    text = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[EMAIL]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\+?\d[\d\s\-()]{7,}\d", "[PHONE]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"https?://\S+|www\.\S+", "[URL]", text)
    return text

def norm_cmp(s):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", str(s or "").lower()).strip()


def parse_cv_title_company(text):
    lines = [l.strip() for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    # try to find "Current" section
    title = ""
    company = ""
    for i, l in enumerate(lines[:40]):
        if l.lower().startswith("current"):
            # look ahead
            for j in range(i+1, min(i+6, len(lines))):
                cand = lines[j]
                if cand.lower() in {"work history","education","skills","languages"}:
                    break
                if not title and len(cand) > 2:
                    title = cand
                    continue
                if title and not company and len(cand) > 1:
                    # heuristic: company often follows title
                    if not re.match(r"^(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec|\d{4}|Present)", cand, re.I):
                        company = cand
                    break
            if title:
                break
    if not title and lines:
        title = lines[0][:120]
    return title, company


def parse_jd_meta(text, jd_id):
    lines = [l.strip() for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()]
    title = ""
    role = ""
    loc = None
    salary = None
    # title often first meaningful line
    for l in lines[:10]:
        if l in {"Finance & Legal","Sales & BD","Marketing","Data & AI","Product","Engineering","Design & Creative"}:
            role = l
            continue
        if not title and len(l) > 3 and "page" not in l.lower():
            # skip Pxx artifacts
            if re.match(r"^P\d{2}", l):
                continue
            title = l
            # don't break immediately, maybe role line appears
    # location/salary lines heuristics
    for l in lines[:30]:
        if "$" in l or "SGD" in l or "MYR" in l or "IDR" in l or "RM" in l:
            salary = l
        if re.search(r"\b(Malaysia|Singapore|Indonesia|Thailand|Hong Kong|Vietnam|Remote)\b", l, re.I):
            # avoid long responsibility lines
            if len(l) < 120:
                loc = l
    # known mappings from prompt
    known = {
        "P01": ("Regional Finance Controller","Finance & Legal","Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia","~$5,550"),
        "P02": ("Sales Manager in Indonesia","Sales & BD","Indonesia","~$6,800"),
        "P03": ("GTM Marketing Manager / Lead","Marketing",None,None),
        "P04": ("Data Engineer","Data & AI","Singapore","S$6,500 - S$9,000"),
        "P05": ("Product Manager - WMS & Warehouse Integrations","Product","Remote","$3,500 - $4,500"),
        "P06": ("Deployment Strategist","Data & AI","Singapore","$7,000 - $10,000"),
        "P07": ("Marketing Manager (HK & SG)","Marketing","Hong Kong / Singapore",None),
        "P08": ("Field Service Engineer (FSE)","Engineering","Singapore",None),
        "P09": ("Tech Lead","Engineering","Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia",None),
        "P10": ("Regional Lead Designer UI/UX","Design & Creative",None,"$4,000 - $5,000"),
    }
    if jd_id in known:
        kt, kr, kl, ks = known[jd_id]
        title = title or kt
        role = kr
        loc = loc if loc else kl
        salary = salary if salary else ks
    return title, role, loc, salary


def dedupe_hired_vs_pool(gt_cvs, pool_cvs, gt_df):
    pool_ids = list(pool_cvs.keys())
    pool_texts = [pool_cvs[i]["raw_text"] for i in pool_ids]
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, stop_words="english")
    if not pool_texts:
        return []
    pool_mat = vec.fit_transform(pool_texts)
    rows = []
    for _, g in gt_df.iterrows():
        cid = g["hired_cv_id"]
        ctext = gt_cvs[cid]["raw_text"]
        cvec = vec.transform([ctext])
        sims = cosine_similarity(cvec, pool_mat)[0]
        top_idx = np.argsort(-sims)[:3]
        top = []
        for ti in top_idx:
            top.append((pool_ids[ti], float(sims[ti])))
        best_id, best_sim = top[0]
        best = pool_cvs[best_id]
        title_match = norm_cmp(g["hired_cv_title"]) == norm_cmp(best.get("title",""))
        comp_match = norm_cmp(g["hired_cv_company"]) == norm_cmp(best.get("company",""))
        is_dup = (best_sim >= 0.95 and title_match and comp_match)
        rows.append({
            "hired_cv_id": cid,
            "jd_id": g["jd_id"],
            "top1_pool_cv": top[0][0], "top1_cosine": round(top[0][1],4),
            "top2_pool_cv": top[1][0], "top2_cosine": round(top[1][1],4),
            "top3_pool_cv": top[2][0], "top3_cosine": round(top[2][1],4),
            "top1_title": best.get("title",""), "top1_company": best.get("company",""),
            "title_match": title_match, "company_match": comp_match,
            "decision": "map_to_existing" if is_dup else "keep_new"
        })
    return rows


def dedupe_jds(unlabelled, gt_jds):
    if not unlabelled or not gt_jds:
        return []
    gt_ids = list(gt_jds.keys())
    gt_texts = [gt_jds[i]["raw_text"] for i in gt_ids]
    un_ids = [u["doc_id"] for u in unlabelled]
    un_texts = [u["raw_text"] for u in unlabelled]
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=5000, stop_words="english")
    all_mat = vec.fit_transform(gt_texts + un_texts)
    gt_mat = all_mat[:len(gt_texts)]
    un_mat = all_mat[len(gt_texts):]
    sims = cosine_similarity(un_mat, gt_mat)
    rows = []
    for i, uid in enumerate(un_ids):
        j = int(np.argmax(sims[i]))
        sim = float(sims[i, j])
        exclude = sim >= 0.90
        rows.append({
            "unlabelled_jd_id": uid,
            "nearest_gt_jd": gt_ids[j],
            "cosine": round(sim,4),
            "exclude_from_training": bool(exclude),
            "reason": "cosine>=0.90" if exclude else "ok"
        })
    return rows


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path
import requests

GENERIC_STOPWORDS = {"experience","experiences","skills","skill","work","team","ability","strong","good","excellent","responsible","develop","manage","build","support","knowledge","understanding"}


def prompt_hash(system_prompt, user_prompt, model):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(model.encode())
    h.update(b"\0")
    h.update(system_prompt.encode())
    h.update(b"\0")
    h.update(user_prompt.encode())
    return h.hexdigest()


def call_ollama(base_url, model, system_prompt, user_prompt, options, timeout=300, think=False):
    payload = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
        ],
        "stream": False,
        "format": "json",
        "options": options,
    }
    if think is False:
        payload["think"] = False
    r = requests.post(base_url.rstrip('/') + '/api/chat', json=payload, timeout=timeout)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    msg = data.get("message", {})
    content = msg.get("content", "")
    return content, data


def extract_json(text):
    if text is None:
        return None
    t = text.strip()
    # strip fences
    t = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", t, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    t = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", t)
    # try direct
    try:
        return json.loads(t, strict=False)
    except Exception:
        pass
    # find first {...}
    m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", t, flags=re.DOTALL)
    if m:
        try:
            return json.loads(m.group(0), strict=False)
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None


def normalize_keyword(kw):
    if kw is None: return None
    s = str(kw).strip()
    s = s.replace("\n", " ")
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)
    s = s.strip(" -•,.;:/")
    return s


def valid_keyword_phrase(kw):
    if not kw: return False
    words = [w for w in re.split(r"\s+", kw) if w]
    if len(words) < 1 or len(words) > 4: return False
    low = kw.lower()
    if low in GENERIC_STOPWORDS: return False
    if len(kw) < 2: return False
    # avoid sentence-like
    if any(p in kw for p in [". ", "!", "?"]): return False
    return True


def keyword_in_text(kw, text, aliases=None):
    aliases = aliases or {}
    low_text = (text or "").lower()
    k = kw.lower()
    if k in low_text:
        return True
    # check alias canonical/raw forms
    if k in aliases and aliases[k].lower() in low_text:
        return True
    # common abbreviations mapping quick checks
    abbr = {
        'gcp':'google cloud','aws':'amazon web services','k8s':'kubernetes','js':'javascript','ts':'typescript',
        'ml':'machine learning','ai':'artificial intelligence','nlp':'natural language processing','sql':'structured query language',
        'ui':'user interface','ux':'user experience','ci/cd':'ci/cd','cicd':'ci/cd','ms excel':'excel','postgres':'postgresql',
        'nodejs':'node.js','reactjs':'react','vuejs':'vue','nextjs':'next.js','powerbi':'power bi','.net':'dotnet'
    }
    if k in abbr and abbr[k] in low_text:
        return True
    # token subset check
    toks = [t for t in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9+#./]+", k) if t]
    if toks and all(t in low_text for t in toks):
        return True
    return False

import argparse, json, os, re, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "group assignment"))

from src.data import mask_pii

CV_FIELDS = ["skills","tools_technologies","domains","education","certifications","languages","locations","soft_skills","work_history"]

        "num_predict": cfg["ollama"]["num_predict"],
        "top_p": cfg["ollama"]["top_p"],

    results_jd = []
    results_cv = []
    times = []

        doc_type = doc["doc_type"]
        is_jd = doc_type in ("gt_jd","unlabelled_jd")
        cache_path = cache_dir / f"{doc_id}.json"
        text = mask_pii(doc.get("raw_text","") or "")
        if len(text) > cfg["extraction"].get("chunk_threshold", 8000):
            # simple truncation/chunk note; basic chunking: split in half
            text_for_prompt = text[:7500] + "\n[...truncated for extraction...]"
            chunked = True
        else:
            text_for_prompt = text
            chunked = False
        tmpl = jd_tmpl if is_jd else cv_tmpl
        user_prompt = tmpl.replace("{DOC_ID}", doc_id).replace("{DOCUMENT_TEXT}", text_for_prompt)
        ph = prompt_hash(system_prompt, user_prompt, model)

        if cache_path.exists() and not args.force:
            try:
                cached = json.loads(cache_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                if cached.get("prompt_hash") == ph and cached.get("status") in ("ok","fallback"):
                    parsed = cached.get("parsed")
                    if parsed:
                        if is_jd: results_jd.append(parsed)
                        else: results_cv.append(parsed)
                        success += 1
                        if cached.get("status")=="fallback": fallback_count += 1
                        continue
            except Exception:
                pass

        t0 = time.time()
        status = "ok"
        raw = ""
        parsed = None
        errs = []
        try:
            raw, meta = call_ollama(base_url, model, system_prompt, user_prompt, options, timeout=timeout, think=cfg["ollama"].get("think", False))
            parsed = extract_json(raw)
            if parsed is None:
                raise ValueError("JSON parse failed")
            parsed, verrs, uns = validate_and_clean(parsed, doc, text)
            errs.extend(verrs)
            unsupported.extend(uns)
            if not parsed:
                raise ValueError("Validation failed")
        except Exception as e:
            errs.append(str(e))
            # retry once
            try:
                corr_prompt = user_prompt + f"\n\nYour previous response was invalid ({e}). Return only one valid JSON object matching the schema."
                raw, meta = call_ollama(base_url, model, system_prompt, corr_prompt, options, timeout=timeout, think=cfg["ollama"].get("think", False))
                parsed = extract_json(raw)
                if parsed is None: raise ValueError("JSON parse failed after retry")
                parsed, verrs, uns = validate_and_clean(parsed, doc, text)
                errs.extend(verrs); unsupported.extend(uns)
            except Exception as e2:
                errs.append(str(e2))
                parsed = deterministic_fallback(doc, text, is_jd)
                status = "fallback"
                fallback_count += 1
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        times.append(elapsed)
        if parsed:
            parsed["doc_id"] = doc_id
            parsed["doc_type"] = "jd" if is_jd else "cv"
            if chunked:
                parsed["merged_from_chunks"] = True
                parsed["chunk_count"] = 1
        cache_obj = {
            "doc_id": doc_id, "doc_type": doc_type, "model": model, "prompt_hash": ph,
            "timestamp": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "elapsed_sec": round(elapsed,3),
            "status": status, "raw_response": raw[:200000] if raw else "", "parsed": parsed, "validation_errors": errs
        }
        cache_path.write_text(json.dumps(cache_obj, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
        if parsed and status in ("ok","fallback"):
            success += 1
            if is_jd: results_jd.append(parsed)
            else: results_cv.append(parsed)
        else:
            failures.append({"doc_id": doc_id, "doc_type": doc_type, "error": "; ".join(errs[-3:])})

        if len(times) % 10 == 0:

    # save outputs
    write_jsonl(proc/"jd_extracted.jsonl", sorted(results_jd, key=lambda x: x.get("doc_id","")))
    write_jsonl(proc/"cv_extracted.jsonl", sorted(results_cv, key=lambda x: x.get("doc_id","")))
    pd.DataFrame(failures).to_csv(proc/"extraction_failures.csv", index=False)
    pd.DataFrame(unsupported).to_csv(proc/"unsupported_keywords.csv", index=False)
    summary = {
        "attempted": len(targets), "success_or_fallback": success, "failures": len(failures),
        "fallback_count": fallback_count, "json_success_rate": (success/len(targets)) if targets else 0,
        "mean_elapsed_sec": sum(times)/len(times) if times else None, "model": model
    }
    (proc/"extraction_summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))


def write_jsonl(path, rows):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for r in rows:
            f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def validate_and_clean(parsed, doc, source_text):
    errs = []
    uns = []
    if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
        return None, ["not a dict"], uns
    is_jd = doc["doc_type"] in ("gt_jd","unlabelled_jd")
    # ensure doc id/type
    parsed["doc_id"] = doc["doc_id"]
    parsed["doc_type"] = "jd" if is_jd else "cv"
    # clean keyword lists
    kw_fields = JD_FIELDS if is_jd else ["skills","tools_technologies","domains","soft_skills"]
    for field in kw_fields:
        val = parsed.get(field)
        if val is None:
            if field in ("must_have_keywords","nice_to_have_keywords","tools_technologies","domain_knowledge","certifications","languages","soft_skills","key_responsibilities","skills","domains","locations"):
                parsed[field] = [] if field != "education" else []
            continue
        if not isinstance(val, list):
            # try split
            if isinstance(val, str):
                val = re.split(r",|;|\n", val)
            else:
                val = []
        cleaned = []
        seen = set()
        for item in val:
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                # keep dicts for education/work_history
                cleaned.append(item)
                continue
            k = normalize_keyword(item)
            if not k: continue
            # split accidental commas
            parts = [normalize_keyword(p) for p in re.split(r",|;", k)] if ("," in k or ";" in k) else [k]
            for p in parts:
                if not p: continue
                if not valid_keyword_phrase(p):
                    # allow some longer domain phrases in domain fields? keep if <=5 words
                    if len(p.split())>5: continue
                if not keyword_in_text(p, source_text):
                    uns.append({"doc_id": doc["doc_id"], "field": field, "keyword": p, "reason": "not_in_source"})
                    continue
                key = p.lower()
                if key in seen: continue
                seen.add(key)
                cleaned.append(p)
        parsed[field] = cleaned
    # required defaults
    if is_jd:
        parsed.setdefault("job_title", doc.get("title"))
        parsed.setdefault("role_family", doc.get("role_family"))
        parsed.setdefault("seniority", "unknown")
        parsed.setdefault("remote", "unknown")
        for f in JD_FIELDS:
            parsed.setdefault(f, [])
    else:
        parsed.setdefault("current_title", doc.get("title"))
        parsed.setdefault("current_company", doc.get("company"))
        parsed.setdefault("role_family", doc.get("role_family"))
        parsed.setdefault("seniority", "unknown")
        for f in CV_FIELDS:
            parsed.setdefault(f, [] if f!="education" and f!="work_history" else [])
    return parsed, errs, uns


def deterministic_fallback(doc, text, is_jd):
    # simple rule-based extraction
    lines = [l.strip("- •\t ") for l in (text or "").splitlines()]
    skills = []
    in_skills = False
    for l in lines:
        if not l: continue
        low = l.lower()
        if any(h in low for h in ["skills", "requirements", "qualifications", "nice to have", "bonus", "technical"]):
            in_skills = True
            # also capture after colon
            if ":" in l:
                tail = l.split(":",1)[1]
                skills.extend([p.strip() for p in re.split(r",|;|\|", tail) if p.strip()])
            continue
        if in_skills:
            if len(l) < 80 and ("," in l or ";" in l or l.startswith("-")):
                skills.extend([p.strip() for p in re.split(r",|;|\|", l) if p.strip()])
            elif len(l.split()) <= 4:
                skills.append(l)
            if len(skills) > 60: break
    skills = [s for s in skills if 1 <= len(s.split()) <= 4][:40]
    if is_jd:
        return {
            "doc_id": doc["doc_id"], "doc_type": "jd", "job_title": doc.get("title"), "role_family": doc.get("role_family"),
            "seniority": "unknown", "location": None, "remote": "unknown", "min_years_experience": None,
            "must_have_keywords": skills[:25], "nice_to_have_keywords": skills[25:35], "tools_technologies": [],
            "domain_knowledge": [], "education_requirements": [], "certifications": [], "languages": [], "soft_skills": [], "key_responsibilities": []
        }
    else:
        return {
            "doc_id": doc["doc_id"], "doc_type": "cv", "current_title": doc.get("title"), "current_company": doc.get("company"),
            "role_family": doc.get("role_family"), "seniority": "unknown", "total_years_experience": None,
            "skills": skills[:30], "tools_technologies": [], "domains": [], "education": [], "certifications": [], "languages": [], "locations": [], "soft_skills": [], "work_history": []
        }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path
import requests

GENERIC_STOPWORDS = {"experience","experiences","skills","skill","work","team","ability","strong","good","excellent","responsible","develop","manage","build","support","knowledge","understanding"}


def prompt_hash(system_prompt, user_prompt, model):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    h.update(model.encode())
    h.update(b"\0")
    h.update(system_prompt.encode())
    h.update(b"\0")
    h.update(user_prompt.encode())
    return h.hexdigest()


def call_ollama(base_url, model, system_prompt, user_prompt, options, timeout=300, think=False):
    url = base_url.rstrip('/') + '/api/chat'
    base_payload = {
        "model": model,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": user_prompt},
        ],
        "stream": False,
        "options": dict(options),
    }
    # try combinations: prefer no-thinking and plain json content
    attempts = []
    p1 = json.loads(json.dumps(base_payload))
    p1["think"] = False
    attempts.append(p1)
    p2 = json.loads(json.dumps(base_payload))
    attempts.append(p2)
    last_err = None
    for payload in attempts:
        try:
            r = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=timeout)
            if r.status_code >= 400:
                last_err = RuntimeError(f"{r.status_code} {r.reason}: {r.text[:300]}")
                continue
            data = r.json()
            msg = data.get("message", {})
            content = msg.get("content", "") or ""
            if not content.strip():
                # some models put answer in thinking; try to extract json from it
                thinking = msg.get("thinking", "") or ""
                content = thinking
            return content, data
        except Exception as e:
            last_err = e
    raise last_err or RuntimeError("ollama call failed")


def extract_json(text):
    if text is None:
        return None
    t = text.strip()
    # strip fences
    t = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*", "", t, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    t = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", t)
    # try direct
    try:
        return json.loads(t, strict=False)
    except Exception:
        pass
    # find balanced-ish json objects by trying from each {
    starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"\{", t)]
    for s in starts:
        # try to parse progressively to end
        for e in range(len(t), s+1, -1):
            if t[e-1] != '}':
                continue
            chunk = t[s:e]
            try:
                return json.loads(chunk, strict=False)
            except Exception:
                continue
    return None


def normalize_keyword(kw):
    if kw is None: return None
    s = str(kw).strip()
    s = s.replace("\n", " ")
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)
    s = s.strip(" -•,.;:/")
    return s


def valid_keyword_phrase(kw):
    if not kw: return False
    words = [w for w in re.split(r"\s+", kw) if w]
    if len(words) < 1 or len(words) > 5: return False
    low = kw.lower()
    if low in GENERIC_STOPWORDS: return False
    if len(kw) < 2: return False
    if any(p in kw for p in [". ", "!", "?"]): return False
    return True


def keyword_in_text(kw, text, aliases=None):
    aliases = aliases or {}
    low_text = (text or "").lower()
    k = kw.lower().strip()
    if not k: return False
    if k in low_text:
        return True
    abbr = {
        'gcp':'google cloud','aws':'amazon web services','k8s':'kubernetes','js':'javascript','ts':'typescript',
        'ml':'machine learning','ai':'artificial intelligence','nlp':'natural language processing','sql':'structured query language',
        'ui':'user interface','ux':'user experience','ci/cd':'continuous integration','cicd':'ci/cd','ms excel':'excel','postgres':'postgresql',
        'nodejs':'node.js','reactjs':'react','vuejs':'vue','nextjs':'next.js','powerbi':'power bi','.net':'dotnet','c#':'c#','c++':'c++',
        'p&l':'profit and loss','fp&a':'financial planning'
    }
    if k in abbr and abbr[k] in low_text:
        return True
    toks = [t for t in re.split(r"[^a-z0-9+#./&]+", k) if t]
    if toks and all(t in low_text for t in toks):
        return True
    if k.endswith('s') and len(k)>3 and k[:-1] in low_text:
        return True
    return False

def main():

        sys.exit(1)
    jd_docs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(jd_path, encoding='utf-8')]
    cv_docs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(cv_path, encoding='utf-8')]

    # training corpus for clustering: pool CVs (100) + unlabelled JDs not excluded (from documents split info)
    docs_meta = {}
    with open(proc/"documents.jsonl", encoding='utf-8') as f:
        for l in f: d=json.loads(l); docs_meta[d['doc_id']] = d
    train_ids = set()
    for did, m in docs_meta.items():
        if m['doc_type']=='pool_cv' and m.get('split')=='train_pool': train_ids.add(did)
        if m['doc_type']=='unlabelled_jd' and m.get('split')=='train_jd': train_ids.add(did)

    # build keyword records
    records = []  # (doc_id, doc_type, field, keyword, weight, in_train)
    def add_kw(doc_id, doc_type, field, kw, weight, in_train):
        if kw is None: return
        if isinstance(kw, dict): return
        s = str(kw).strip()
        if not s: return
        records.append((doc_id, doc_type, field, s, weight, in_train))

    for d in jd_docs:
        did=d.get('doc_id'); in_train = did in train_ids
        for k in d.get('must_have_keywords',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'jd','must_have_keywords',k,3.0,in_train)
        for k in d.get('nice_to_have_keywords',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'jd','nice_to_have_keywords',k,1.0,in_train)
        for k in d.get('tools_technologies',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'jd','tools_technologies',k,2.0,in_train)
        for k in d.get('domain_knowledge',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'jd','domain_knowledge',k,1.5,in_train)
        for k in d.get('key_responsibilities',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'jd','key_responsibilities',k,0.5,in_train)
        for k in d.get('soft_skills',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'jd','soft_skills',k,0.5,in_train)
    for d in cv_docs:
        did=d.get('doc_id'); in_train = did in train_ids
        for k in d.get('skills',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'cv','skills',k,2.0,in_train)
        for k in d.get('tools_technologies',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'cv','tools_technologies',k,2.0,in_train)
        for k in d.get('domains',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'cv','domains',k,1.5,in_train)
        for k in d.get('soft_skills',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'cv','soft_skills',k,0.5,in_train)
        for k in d.get('certifications',[]) or []: add_kw(did,'cv','certifications',k,0.5,in_train)
        for edu in (d.get('education') or []):
            if isinstance(edu, dict):
                for f in ['degree','field']: 
                    if edu.get(f): add_kw(did,'cv','education',edu.get(f),0.5,in_train)

    alias_map = {normalize_keyword_str(r): c for r,c in CURATED_ALIASES}
    # also add common variants
    def canonicalize(raw):
        n = normalize_keyword_str(raw)
        if not n: return None
        if n in alias_map: return alias_map[n]
        # protected / known tech tokens keep form
        # simple singularize
        if n.endswith('ies') and len(n)>5: cand = n[:-3]+'y'
        elif n.endswith('s') and len(n)>4 and n not in PROTECTED and not n.endswith('ss'): cand = n[:-1]
        else: cand = n
        if cand in alias_map: return alias_map[cand]
        # return cleaned display form
        return raw.strip()

    # build stats (training corpus focus for clustering)
    train_records = [r for r in records if r[5]]

    # map raw->canonical
    raw_to_canon = {}
    for r in records:

    alias_rows = []

    pd.DataFrame(alias_rows).to_csv(proc/"keyword_aliases.csv", index=False)

    # keyword table on training corpus
    kw_docs = defaultdict(set); kw_freq = Counter(); kw_fields = defaultdict(set)
    for doc_id, doc_type, field, kw, w, in_train in train_records:
        c = canonicalize(kw) or kw.strip()
        if not c: continue
        kw_docs[c].add(doc_id); kw_freq[c]+=1; kw_fields[c].add(field)
    kw_table = []
    for k in sorted(kw_docs.keys(), key=lambda x: (-len(kw_docs[x]), x.lower())):
        kw_table.append({"keyword":k, "doc_frequency":len(kw_docs[k]), "total_frequency":kw_freq[k], "fields":"|".join(sorted(kw_fields[k]))})
    pd.DataFrame(kw_table).to_csv(proc/"keyword_table_train.csv", index=False)

    unique_keywords = list(kw_docs.keys())
    if len(unique_keywords) == 0:

    # embeddings: char TF-IDF + SVD (offline, deterministic)
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb", ngram_range=(3,5), min_df=1, sublinear_tf=True)
    X = vec.fit_transform(unique_keywords)
    n_comp = min(100, X.shape[1]-1, X.shape[0]-1)
    n_comp = max(2, n_comp)
    svd = TruncatedSVD(n_components=n_comp, random_state=42)
    emb = svd.fit_transform(X)
    # normalize
    norms = np.linalg.norm(emb, axis=1, keepdims=True); norms[norms==0]=1
    emb_n = emb / norms

    # choose threshold to target 100-200 clusters
    thresholds = [0.25,0.30,0.35,0.40,0.45]
    best_labels = None; best_t = 0.35; best_k = 0
    for t in thresholds:
        cl = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, distance_threshold=t, metric='cosine', linkage='average')
        labels = cl.fit_predict(emb_n)
        k = len(set(labels))
        if 100 <= k <= 200:
            best_labels, best_t, best_k = labels, t, k
            break
    if best_labels is None:
        # pick closest to range
        def score(t):
            cl = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, distance_threshold=t, metric='cosine', linkage='average')
            labels = cl.fit_predict(emb_n); k=len(set(labels)); return labels,k
        cand = [score(t) for t in thresholds]
        # prefer >=100 else closest
        cand.sort(key=lambda x: (0 if 100<=x[1]<=200 else 1, abs(x[1]-150)))
        best_labels, best_k = cand[0][0], cand[0][1]; best_t = thresholds[[len(set(score(t)[0])) for t in thresholds].index(best_k)] if False else 0.35
        # recompute best_t properly
        for t in thresholds:
            cl = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=None, distance_threshold=t, metric='cosine', linkage='average')
            labels = cl.fit_predict(emb_n); k=len(set(labels))
            if k==best_k: best_t=t; best_labels=labels; break

    # build clusters and apply guardrails (simple blocklist check)
    cluster_members = defaultdict(list)
    for kw, lab in zip(unique_keywords, best_labels):
        cluster_members[int(lab)].append(kw)
    # split clusters violating confusable blocklist
    final_clusters = {}
    next_id = 0
    for lab, members in cluster_members.items():
        groups = split_confusable(members)
        for g in groups:
            final_clusters[next_id] = g
            next_id += 1

    # canonical labels and stats
    freq_map = {k: len(kw_docs[k]) for k in unique_keywords}
    tot_map = {k: kw_freq[k] for k in unique_keywords}
    cluster_rows = []
    kw_to_cluster = {}
    for cid, members in final_clusters.items():
        members_sorted = sorted(members, key=lambda x: (-freq_map.get(x,0), x.lower()))
        canon = members_sorted[0]
        # prefer alias canonical form
        for m in members_sorted:
            if normalize_keyword_str(m) in alias_map: canon = alias_map[normalize_keyword_str(m)]; break
        size = len(members)
        dfreq = sum(freq_map.get(m,0) for m in members)  # approximate doc coverage sum
        tfreq = sum(tot_map.get(m,0) for m in members)
        # coherence
        idxs = [unique_keywords.index(m) for m in members if m in unique_keywords]
        if len(idxs) >= 2:
            sim = cosine_similarity(emb_n[idxs])
            coh = float((sim.sum()-len(idxs)) / (len(idxs)*(len(idxs)-1)))

                              "merge_method":"agglomerative_char_tfidf_svd", "confidence":"medium"})

def split_confusable(members):

    groups = [members]
    for a_set, b_set in CONFUSABLE_BLOCKLIST:
        new_groups = []
        for g in groups:
            ga, gb, other = [], [], []
            for m in g:
                mt = toks(m) | {m.lower().strip()}
                in_a = any(x in mt or x in m.lower() for x in a_set)
                in_b = any(x in mt or x in m.lower() for x in b_set)
                if in_a and not in_b: ga.append(m)
                elif in_b and not in_a: gb.append(m)
                elif in_a and in_b:
                    # ambiguous, assign by exact
                    if m.lower().strip() in a_set: ga.append(m)
                    elif m.lower().strip() in b_set: gb.append(m)
                    else: other.append(m)
                else: other.append(m)
            # if both sides present, split
            if ga and gb:
                if ga: new_groups.append(ga)
                if gb: new_groups.append(gb)
                # assign other to larger
                if other:
                    target = ga if len(ga)>=len(gb) else gb
                    target.extend(other)
            else:
                new_groups.append(g)
        groups = new_groups
    return groups if groups else [members]

import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class AE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, latent_dim=32, hidden_dims=(256,64), dropout=0.2):
        super().__init__()
        h1,h2 = hidden_dims
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(input_dim, h1), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(h1, h2), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(h2, latent_dim)
        )
        self.decoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(latent_dim, h2), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(h2, h1), nn.GELU(), nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(h1, input_dim)
        )
    def forward(self, x):
        z = self.encoder(x)
        out = self.decoder(z)
        return out, z

    X_svd = svd.fit_transform(X_tfidf)
    X_svd = X_svd / (np.linalg.norm(X_svd, axis=1, keepdims=True)+1e-9)

    # candidates: all CVs
    cand_ids = [d['doc_id'] for d in docs if d['doc_type'] in ('pool_cv','gt_cv')]
    cand_ids = sorted(cand_ids)
    jd_ids = gt['jd_id'].tolist()
    N = len(cand_ids)

    # embeddings dict
    dim_cols = [c for c in emb.columns if c.startswith('dim_')]
    E = {r['doc_id']: r[dim_cols].values.astype(np.float32) for _,r in emb.iterrows()}

    def cosine(a,b):
        return float(np.dot(a,b) / ((np.linalg.norm(a)*np.linalg.norm(b))+1e-9))

    # must-have coverage
    def must_have_set(jd_id):
        ext = jd_ext.get(jd_id, {})
        must = ext.get('must_have_keywords',[]) or []
        s = set()
        for k in must:
            cid = ktc_n.get(str(k)) or ktc_n.get(str(k).lower())
            if cid is not None: s.add(int(cid))
        return s
    def cv_cluster_set(cv_id):
        ext = cv_ext.get(cv_id, {})
        s = set()
        for field in ['skills','tools_technologies','domains']:
            for k in (ext.get(field) or []):
                cid = ktc_n.get(str(k)) or ktc_n.get(str(k).lower())
                if cid is not None: s.add(int(cid))
        # include education/certs tokens? minimal
        for k in (ext.get('certifications') or []):
            cid = ktc_n.get(str(k)) or ktc_n.get(str(k).lower())
            if cid is not None: s.add(int(cid))
        return s

    must_sets = {j: must_have_set(j) for j in jd_ids}
    cv_sets = {c: cv_cluster_set(c) for c in cand_ids}

    # precompute role families
    cand_role = {c: docs_by_id[c].get('role_family') for c in cand_ids}
    jd_role = {j: docs_by_id[j].get('role_family') for j in jd_ids}

    rankings = []
    top10 = []
    models_list = ['M0_random','M1_tfidf','M2_svd32','M3_ae32','M4_ae_meta','M5_hybrid','M6_role_heuristic']

    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    # one representative random permutation per JD (seeded per jd for determinism)
    for model in models_list:
        for jd_id in jd_ids:
            scores = {}
            if model == 'M0_random':
                perm = rng.permutation(cand_ids)
                for rank, cid in enumerate(perm, start=1):
                    scores[cid] = (1.0/(rank), rank)  # store score proxy
                # we'll assign by perm
                order = list(perm)
            elif model == 'M1_tfidf':
                qi = id_to_row[jd_id]; qv = X_tfidf[qi]
                for cid in cand_ids:
                    ci = id_to_row[cid]; scores[cid] = float(np.dot(qv, X_tfidf[ci])/(np.linalg.norm(qv)*np.linalg.norm(X_tfidf[ci])+1e-9))
            elif model == 'M2_svd32':
                qi = id_to_row[jd_id]; qv = X_svd[qi]
                for cid in cand_ids:
                    ci = id_to_row[cid]; scores[cid] = cosine(qv, X_svd[ci])
            elif model == 'M3_ae32':
                qv = E[jd_id]
                for cid in cand_ids: scores[cid] = cosine(qv, E[cid])
            elif model == 'M4_ae_meta':
                qv = E[jd_id]
                for cid in cand_ids:
                    base = cosine(qv, E[cid])
                    meta_bonus = 0.0
                    if cand_role.get(cid) and cand_role.get(cid)==jd_role.get(jd_id): meta_bonus += 0.1
                    scores[cid] = 0.7*base + 0.3*meta_bonus
            elif model == 'M5_hybrid':
                qv = E[jd_id]; ms = must_sets.get(jd_id,set())
                for cid in cand_ids:
                    base = cosine(qv, E[cid])
                    cov = 0.0
                    if ms: cov = len(ms & cv_sets.get(cid,set()))/len(ms)
                    scores[cid] = 0.8*base + 0.2*cov
            elif model == 'M6_role_heuristic':
                qv = E[jd_id]
                for cid in cand_ids:
                    base = cosine(qv, E[cid])
                    same = 1.0 if (cand_role.get(cid) and cand_role.get(cid)==jd_role.get(jd_id)) else 0.0
                    scores[cid] = same*10 + base
            if model != 'M0_random':
                order = sorted(cand_ids, key=lambda c: (-round(scores[c],6), c))
            hired = gt.loc[gt['jd_id']==jd_id, 'hired_cv_id'].iloc[0]
            for rank, cid in enumerate(order, start=1):
                sc = scores[cid] if model!='M0_random' else 1.0/rank
                if isinstance(sc, tuple): sc = sc[0]
                rankings.append({"model":model,"jd_id":jd_id,"cv_id":cid,"rank":rank,"score":round(float(sc),6),"is_relevant": int(cid==hired)})

    rank_df = pd.DataFrame(rankings)
    rank_df.to_csv(proc/"rankings.csv", index=False)

    # top10 with reasons
    cluster_labels = dict(zip(clusters['cluster_id'].astype(int), clusters['canonical_label']))
    for model in models_list:
        for jd_id in jd_ids:
            sub = rank_df[(rank_df.model==model)&(rank_df.jd_id==jd_id)].sort_values('rank').head(10)
            hired = gt.loc[gt['jd_id']==jd_id,'hired_cv_id'].iloc[0]
            ms = must_sets.get(jd_id,set())
            for _, r in sub.iterrows():
                cid = r['cv_id']; ext = cv_ext.get(cid,{})
                cov_ids = ms & cv_sets.get(cid,set()) if ms else set()
                missing = list(ms - cov_ids)
                cov_names = [cluster_labels.get(i,str(i)) for i in list(cov_ids)[:5]]
                miss_names = [cluster_labels.get(i,str(i)) for i in missing[:3]]
                coverage_txt = f"Matches {len(cov_ids)}/{len(ms)} must-have skills" if ms else "Matches 0/0 must-have skills"
                if cov_names: coverage_txt += f" ({', '.join(cov_names)})"
                if miss_names: coverage_txt += f"; missing {', '.join(miss_names)}"
                meta_doc = docs_by_id.get(cid,{})
                reason = coverage_txt + f". Role family: {meta_doc.get('role_family','')}. Score {r['score']:.3f}."
                top10.append({
                    "model":model,"jd_id":jd_id,"rank":int(r['rank']),"cv_id":cid,
                    "cv_title":ext.get('current_title') or meta_doc.get('title'),
                    "cv_company":ext.get('current_company') or meta_doc.get('company'),
                    "role_family":meta_doc.get('role_family'),
                    "score":r['score'],"is_relevant":int(r['is_relevant']),
                    "must_have_matches":len(cov_ids),"missing_must_haves":"; ".join(miss_names), "reason":reason[:600]

            hired = gt.loc[gt['jd_id']==jd_id,'hired_cv_id'].iloc[0]
            hit1=int(rank<=1); hit5=int(rank<=5); hit10=int(rank<=10)
            rr = (1.0/rank) if rank<=10 else 0.0
            ndcg = (1.0/math.log2(rank+1)) if rank<=10 else 0.0
            top1 = sub.iloc[0]
            ms = must_sets.get(jd_id,set())
            cov = (len(ms & cv_sets.get(hired,set()))/len(ms)) if ms else 0.0
            metrics_rows.append({
                "model":model,"jd_id":jd_id,"jd_title":gt.loc[gt.jd_id==jd_id,'jd_title'].iloc[0],
                "role_family":gt.loc[gt.jd_id==jd_id,'role_family'].iloc[0],"hired_cv_id":hired,
                "rank":rank,"score":float(rel.iloc[0]['score']) if len(rel) else None,
                "hit_at_1":hit1,"hit_at_5":hit5,"hit_at_10":hit10,
                "reciprocal_rank":rr,"ndcg_at_10":ndcg,"must_have_coverage_hired":round(cov,4),
                "top1_cv_id":top1['cv_id'],"top1_score":float(top1['score']),"score_margin": (float(rel.iloc[0]['score'])-float(top1['score'])) if len(rel) else None
            })
    mdf = pd.DataFrame(metrics_rows)
    mdf.to_csv(proc/"metrics_per_query.csv", index=False)

    for model in models_list:
        sub = mdf[mdf.model==model]
        n=len(sub); hits=int(sub['hit_at_10'].sum())
        recall = hits/n if n else 0
        hit1=sub['hit_at_1'].mean(); hit5=sub['hit_at_5'].mean(); mrr=sub['reciprocal_rank'].mean(); ndcg=sub['ndcg_at_10'].mean()
        prec=sub['hit_at_10'].mean()/10.0
        # Wilson CI
        z=1.96; p=recall
        denom=1+z*z/n; center=(p+z*z/(2*n))/denom; margin=z*math.sqrt((p*(1-p)+z*z/(4*n))/n)/denom
        wlo=max(0.0, center-margin); whi=min(1.0, center+margin)
        # bootstrap
        vals=sub['hit_at_10'].values.astype(float)
        rngb=np.random.default_rng(42)
        boots=[rngb.choice(vals,size=n,replace=True).mean() for _ in range(10000)]
        blo, bhi = np.percentile(boots,[2.5,97.5])
        summary_rows.append({"model":model,"n_queries":n,"hits":hits,"recall_at_10":round(recall,6),
            "hit_at_1":round(float(hit1),6),"hit_at_5":round(float(hit5),6),"mrr_at_10":round(float(mrr),6),
            "ndcg_at_10":round(float(ndcg),6),"precision_at_10":round(float(prec),6),
            "wilson_ci_low":round(wlo,6),"wilson_ci_high":round(whi,6),"bootstrap_ci_low":round(float(blo),6),"bootstrap_ci_high":round(float(bhi),6)})
    sdf = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
    sdf.to_csv(proc/"metrics_summary.csv", index=False)

    # ablation
    abl = sdf[['model','recall_at_10','hit_at_1','mrr_at_10']].copy()
    notes = {'M0_random':'uniform random baseline','M1_tfidf':'TF-IDF keyword cosine','M2_svd32':'SVD-32 cosine','M3_ae32':'Primary: AE-32 cosine','M4_ae_meta':'AE + metadata heuristic','M5_hybrid':'AE + must-have coverage (exploratory)','M6_role_heuristic':'Role-family heuristic'}
    abl['notes']=abl['model'].map(notes)
    abl.to_csv(proc/"ablation_results.csv", index=False)

    # random baseline empirical over 1000 perms
    gt_map = dict(zip(gt['jd_id'], gt['hired_cv_id']))
    emp=[]
    rng2=np.random.default_rng(42)
    for _ in range(1000):
        hits=0
        for jd_id in jd_ids:
            perm = rng2.permutation(cand_ids)
            rank = int(np.where(perm==gt_map[jd_id])[0][0])+1
            if rank<=10: hits+=1
        emp.append(hits/len(jd_ids))
    pd.DataFrame({"recall_at_10":emp}).to_csv(proc/"random_baseline.csv", index=False)
    print(sdf.to_string(index=False))
    print('expected_random', 10/N)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse, json, re, sys
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "group assignment"))
from src.config import load_config, add_common_args

def norm(s):
    s = str(s or '').lower().strip()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9+#./ ]+", " ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(); add_common_args(parser); args = parser.parse_args()
    cfg = load_config(args.config)
    root = Path(cfg['_project_root']); out = Path(cfg['_out_dir']); proc = out/'data'/'processed'; tables = out/'results'/'tables'
    tables.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    from src.data import load_excel
    _, cv_xls = load_excel(root / cfg['paths']['xlsx'])
    cv_xls['Ref']=cv_xls['Ref'].astype(str).str.strip()
    cv_ext = {d['doc_id']: d for d in [json.loads(l) for l in open(proc/'cv_extracted.jsonl', encoding='utf-8')]}
    rows=[]
    for _, r in cv_xls.iterrows():
        ref=r['Ref']; ext=cv_ext.get(ref,{})
        excel_skills = str(r.get('Skills','') or '')
        ex_set = set([norm(x) for x in re.split(r',|;|\n|\|', excel_skills) if norm(x)])
        llm_set = set([norm(x) for x in (ext.get('skills',[]) or []) + (ext.get('tools_technologies',[]) or []) if norm(x)])
        inter = len(ex_set & llm_set)
        prec = inter/len(llm_set) if llm_set else 0.0
        rec = inter/len(ex_set) if ex_set else 0.0
        f1 = 2*prec*rec/(prec+rec) if (prec+rec) else 0.0
        rows.append({'ref':ref,'excel_count':len(ex_set),'llm_count':len(llm_set),'precision':prec,'recall':rec,'f1':f1})
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    df.to_csv(proc/'extraction_quality.csv', index=False)
    summary = {'macro_precision':float(df['precision'].mean()), 'macro_recall':float(df['recall'].mean()), 'macro_f1':float(df['f1'].mean()), 'n':len(df)}
    pd.DataFrame([summary]).to_csv(tables/'extraction_quality_summary.csv', index=False)
    df.sort_values('f1').head(5).to_csv(tables/'extraction_quality_worst5.csv', index=False)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
PY

Reproducible baseline pipeline for CV–JD matching: parse documents, extract structured keywords with a local LLM (Ollama), merge/cluster keywords, train an autoencoder representation, rank candidates by cosine similarity, evaluate Recall@10 on 10 labelled pairs, and present results in a Streamlit app.

0. `00_validate_data.py` — parse/split PDFs, manifests, GT, dedupe/alignment checks.

def set_seed(seed=42):

def main():

            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('nice_to_have_keywords',[]), 1.0, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('tools_technologies',[]), 2.0, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('domain_knowledge',[]), 1.5, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('key_responsibilities',[]), 0.5, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('soft_skills',[]), 0.5, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
        else:
            ext = cv_ext.get(did, {})
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('skills',[]), 2.0, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('tools_technologies',[]), 2.0, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('domains',[]), 1.5, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)
            add_weighted(vec, ext.get('soft_skills',[]), 0.5, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, did)

    sparse_counts = sparse.csr_matrix(X_counts)
    sparse.save_npz(proc/"document_keyword_matrix.npz", sparse_counts)
    tfidf = TfidfTransformer(sublinear_tf=True, norm='l2')

    vec_info = {"cluster_ids": cluster_ids, "idf": tfidf.idf_.tolist(), "n_clusters": n_clusters, "doc_ids": doc_ids}
    with open(models/"vectorizer.json","w",encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(vec_info, f)

    heldout_mask = np.array([(docs_by_id[d]['doc_type'] in ('gt_jd','gt_cv')) for d in doc_ids])

                       alpha=1e-4, batch_size=min(32,len(X_train)), learning_rate_init=1e-3,
                       max_iter=500, early_stopping=True, n_iter_no_change=40, validation_fraction=0.15,
                       random_state=42, verbose=False)
    # fit on training corpus only (primary protocol)
    mlp.fit(X_train, X_train)
    # "best epoch"/loss not directly exposed same way; use loss_curve_
    history = []
    for i,(tr,va) in enumerate(zip(getattr(mlp,'loss_curve_',[]), getattr(mlp,'validation_scores_',[]))):
        history.append({"epoch":i+1,"train_mse":float(tr),"val_mse":float(1-va) if va is not None else None})
    if not history and hasattr(mlp,'loss_curve_'):
        for i,tr in enumerate(mlp.loss_curve_):
            history.append({"epoch":i+1,"train_mse":float(tr),"val_mse":None})
    pd.DataFrame(history).to_csv(models/"ae_training_history.csv", index=False)
    best_epoch = getattr(mlp,'n_iter_', len(history))

    # extract bottleneck activations (encoder part: layers 0,1 -> 256,64, latent at 2)
    Z = encode_mlp(mlp, X_dense, latent_layer_index=2)
    zn = Z / (np.linalg.norm(Z, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-9)
    emb_cols = [f"dim_{i+1:02d}" for i in range(Z.shape[1])]
    emb_df = pd.DataFrame(zn, columns=emb_cols)

    emb_df.insert(0,'split',[docs_by_id[d].get('split') for d in doc_ids])
    emb_df.insert(0,'doc_type',[docs_by_id[d].get('doc_type') for d in doc_ids])
    emb_df.insert(0,'doc_id',doc_ids)
    emb_df.to_csv(proc/"document_embeddings.csv", index=False)

    # save model
    import pickle

    # also save a torch-like placeholder note? keep autoencoder.pt name not applicable; save config
    recon = mlp.predict(X_dense)

    ae_config = {
        "input_dim": int(input_dim), "latent_dim": latent_dim, "hidden_dims": [256,64],
        "dropout": 0.0, "denoising": False, "seed": 42, "best_epoch": int(best_epoch),
        "validation_mse": val_mse, "cluster_count": n_clusters, "train_docs": int(len(X_train)),
        "val_docs": int(len(X_val)), "heldout_docs": int(len(np.where(heldout_mask)[0])),
        "protocol": "primary_holdout_gt", "implementation": "sklearn_mlp_autoencoder"
    }
    with open(models/"autoencoder_config.json","w",encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(ae_config, f, indent=2)

    make_ae_figures(history, best_epoch, X_dense, recon, Z, docs_by_id, doc_ids, out, models, figs, tables, ae_config)
    print(json.dumps(ae_config, indent=2))

def encode_mlp(mlp, X, latent_layer_index=2):
    # forward through layers up to latent_layer_index (0-based hidden layer outputs after activation)
    # MLPRegressor: coefs_[i], intercepts_[i] for layer i; activation on hidden layers, identity on output
    hidden_activation = mlp.activation  # 'relu'
    A = X
    for i in range(latent_layer_index+1):
        A = A @ mlp.coefs_[i] + mlp.intercepts_[i]
        if hidden_activation == 'relu':
            A = np.maximum(A, 0)
        elif hidden_activation == 'tanh':
            A = np.tanh(A)
        elif hidden_activation == 'logistic':
            A = 1/(1+np.exp(-A))
    return A.astype(np.float32)

def add_weighted(vec, kws, weight, ktc, cid_to_idx, unmatched, doc_id):
    if not kws: return
    for kw in kws:
        if isinstance(kw, dict): continue
        s = str(kw).strip()
        if not s: continue
        cid = ktc.get(s) or ktc.get(s.lower())
        if cid is None:
            unmatched.append({"doc_id":doc_id, "keyword":s, "reason":"unmatched"})

        idx = cid_to_idx.get(int(cid))
        if idx is not None:
            vec[idx] += weight

    plt.savefig(figs/'07_ae_loss_curves.png', dpi=200); plt.close()

    mse = ((recon-X_dense)**2).mean(axis=1)
    types = [docs_by_id[d]['doc_type'] for d in doc_ids]

    for t in sorted(set(types)):

    for i,lab in enumerate(labels):

        if i < len(labels)-1: ax.arrow(i*1.3+1.0,0.6,0.3,0,head_width=0.05,length_includes_head=True)

    pca = PCA(n_components=2, random_state=42); Z2 = pca.fit_transform(Z)
    plot_latent(Z2, doc_ids, docs_by_id, figs/'09_latent_space_pca.png', 'Latent Space PCA (2D)', out)

        ev = float(np.sum(getattr(red,'explained_variance_ratio_', [np.nan])))
        rows.append({'method':name,'mse':mse_r,'explained_variance':ev})
    ae_mse = float(((recon-X_dense)**2).mean())
    rows.append({'method':'AE-32','mse':ae_mse,'explained_variance':np.nan})
    pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv(tables/'ae_vs_svd.csv', index=False)

    ex_rows=[]
    sample = [d for d in doc_ids if docs_by_id[d]['doc_type']=='pool_cv'][:3] + [d for d in doc_ids if docs_by_id[d]['doc_type']=='gt_jd'][:2]
    for did in sample:
        i = doc_ids.index(did)
        top_in = np.argsort(-X_dense[i])[:10]; top_out = np.argsort(-recon[i])[:10]
        ex_rows.append({'doc_id':did,'top_input_idx':','.join(map(str,top_in.tolist())),'top_recon_idx':','.join(map(str,top_out.tolist()))})
    pd.DataFrame(ex_rows).to_csv(tables/'reconstruction_examples.csv', index=False)
    plt.figure(figsize=(6,3)); plt.text(0.01,0.5,'Reconstruction examples saved to results/tables/reconstruction_examples.csv', fontsize=10)
    plt.axis('off'); plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig(figs/'08b_ae_reconstruction_examples.png', dpi=200); plt.close()

def plot_latent(Z2, doc_ids, docs_by_id, path, title, out):

    type_colors = {'pool_cv':'#4C78A8','gt_cv':'#F58518','gt_jd':'#54A24B','unlabelled_jd':'#B279A2'}
